column1: # Trees to benchmark, one per line. Columns are tab-separated:
#   name    label used in the results CSV and in console output
#   dir     checkout location: "." is this repo, anything else resolves
#           against $KAPPAI_BENCH_DIR (default ~/kappai-bench)
#   build   build output dir, relative to `dir`
#   flag    CLI backend-selection flag for this tree's vintage
#   dev     backend name to pass to that flag
#   cuda    1 if this tree has a CUDA backend, else 0
# Each `dir` must be a real git checkout with that build present: bench.py
# shells out to `git -C <dir> rev-parse HEAD` to stamp every result row with
# the commit it actually measured, and records the engine lib md5 so a stale
# build cannot be compared by accident.
# Usage:
#   KAPPAI_BENCH_DIR=/path/to/dir python3 bench.py <model.gguf> <tag> <blocks> [cuda|cpu|all]
# Label changes: the recorded CSVs predate the rename and say `fork`/`prefix`/
# `dev` where this file now says `pre-merge-fork`/`post-merge-pre-fix`/
# `dev-master`. The CSVs were left exactly as measured; only labels changed,
# never the numbers. CUDA_PORTING.md has the human-readable table.
dev-master
pre-merge-fork
post-merge-pre-fix
current
